system.description:
Your network works to advance your schemes. Choose two from the list below and announce to everyone what these schemes are. You cannot have more than two at a time. At the start of a session, you may swap one out for another.

  • Seize Property. Choose a known property or valuable object. You have someone keeping an eye on it full time. When it changes hands, you know.
  • Opportunity. Choose someone who has, in your opinion, wronged you. Your network will let you know immediately when they are alone.
  • Protection. Choose a character or thing your network protects. They keep them safe from death and serious harm as long as they are under your protection.
  • Bring Them Together. Choose two characters. You convinced society that they belong and are together. When they are intimate with others, you learn of it.
  • Keep Them Apart. Choose two characters. Through your machinations, you are keeping them apart. When they make plans to meet, you learn of them.
